description: The AFC mark, colours and sign-in button, for partners building with Sign in with AFC.
heading: AFC brand
intro: Everything you need to put AFC on your site correctly. If you are adding a Sign in with AFC button, the button section below is the part to copy.
apiNote: All of this is also readable as JSON, so you can pull it into a build step instead of copying by hand.

mark.heading: The mark
mark.body: One mark, five sizes. Pick the size closest to the box you are drawing it in, then let it scale down rather than up.
mark.resolutionBody: The AFC mark exists as a 500 pixel PNG and nothing larger. Drawn above that it goes soft, so 500 is the biggest size published. If you need it bigger than that, ask us rather than scaling it.

button.heading: The sign-in button
button.body: Use the short name. "African Free Fire Community" set as a button label makes the button roughly twice the width of every other provider on the row, which is what it looked like before this page existed.
button.label: Continue with AFC
button.codeNote: Plain HTML and CSS, no dependency. The mark is served from AFC, so it updates if we ever change it.

colors.heading: Colours
colors.body: One green does the work. The gold is for prizes, tiers and winners, never as a second brand colour.
colors.copyHint: Click a value to copy it

rules.heading: Using the mark
do: Show the mark beside the words, at the same visual weight as the other sign-in buttons on the row.
Keep clear space around the mark of at least a quarter of its width.
Put it on a surface with real contrast behind it, light or dark.
dont: Do not stretch, rotate, recolour or add effects to the mark.
Do not draw it larger than 500 pixels. There is no vector, so it will go soft.
Do not use the full name as a button label.
Do not imply AFC endorses your product. The button means a player can sign in, nothing more.

api.heading: Read it as JSON
api.body: The same names, colours, logo URLs and rules, in one unauthenticated request. It needs no key, because you draw this button before anyone has signed in.

questions.heading: Something missing
questions.body: If you need the mark in a format that is not here, or you are not sure whether a use is allowed, ask before you ship it.
